about.name: Harsh Walia
about.title: MSc Investments
about.bio: I am an MSc Investments student at the University of Birmingham. I research listed companies, build the valuation models behind that research, and publish both here. Most of my work is in equity research and valuation — discounted cash flow, dividend discount and residual income models — built in Excel and Python.

technicalSkills.name: Valuation modelling — DCF, DDM, residual income, trading comparables
Python and Stata for financial data and econometrics
Excel — financial modelling, Power Query, VBA
